title: Ettrian - The Elf Prince
description:
План развитияPlaying on gamepad is highly recommended

Об игреWitness the Betrayal

Ettrian - The Elf Prince is a turn-based RPG set in the magical world of Yumhia. Step into the shoes of Ettrian, a 14-year-old elf prince grappling with betrayal from his own human siblings, even though they are part of the royal family of Atlantus, ruled by King Tularic.

Ettrian's journey is fraught with danger and mystery. He must navigate the treacherous aftermath of an ambush and unravel the enigma surrounding the Dark Temple.

To survive and thrive, Ettrian must pass a series of rigorous trials and tap into his latent powers.

The game features the Ethereum Nexus, a grid-based skill tree that reflects the unique abilities encoded in Ettrian's DNA. This system allows players to unlock incredible skills with the bow and arrow, infusing them with arcane magic and enhancing their stats to face the challenges ahead.

Engage in classic turn-based battles. Use straightforward commands to defeat enemies, perfect for easing into the game’s combat system. As the game progresses, combat becomes more intricate. Employ strategic thinking to master advanced commands and ensure your survival.

With its engaging turn-based combat, Ettrian - The Elf Prince offers a deep and strategic gameplay experience. Players must master the intricacies of battle, utilizing a variety of magical abilities and tactical maneuvers to defeat formidable foes.

Explore the immersive world of Yumhia, filled with diverse environments, hidden secrets, and compelling characters.

Dive deep into a rich storyline filled with intrigue, danger, and self-discovery. Every decision you make will shape Ettrian's destiny and influence the fate of the kingdom of Atlantus.

"The veils of fate grow thinner as unworthy trespassers disturb the sacred balance. A shadow rises, yet the light of the chosen one cannot be extinguished. The true heir shall answer the call, for this temple's destiny is bound not to the living, but to the blood of ancient promise."
description_short: Раскройте скрытые истины и обуздайте древние силы, чтобы восстановить его честь. Погрузитесь в 'Ettrian - The Elf Prince', где каждая тень шепчет секреты, а каждый свет несет надежду.
